name: mirage
text: Yes, that's doable and I'm adding it (LG4): when you tap Bet, the phone would send the order to the GitHub engine, which places it with its own key and sends you the notification when it fills. It needs the engine's trading on Live and keeps the same limits. I'll ship the lag fix first (bid guard off while the engine runs bids), then build this. Agreed that GitHub should do nearly all the processing.
